# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 3 tokens; Text — 3 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 3 tokens; Borders and rings — 2 tokens; Charts — 6 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 19 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 8 tokens; Radius — 4 tokens; Shadow — 1 token; Size — 7 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--surface, #ffffff);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--surface, #16191f);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #ffffff;
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--surface` | #ffffff | #16191f | Cards, tables, panels, sidebar. The default container for content. |
| `--surface-sunken` | #efefec | #121419 | Wells inside a surface: code blocks, tool-call output, table header row, input groups. |

**Interaction states** (same roles, suffixed):

| token | light | dark |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--surface-hover` | #f2f2ef | #1d2129 |

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--fg, #18181b);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */

/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #18181b;
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--fg` | #18181b | #ececef | Primary text and icons on bg, surface and surface-sunken. |
| `--fg-muted` | #55575e | #a3a6ae | Secondary text: descriptions, table metadata, labels. Legible on bg, surface, surface-sunken. |
| `--fg-subtle` | #6b6d74 | #878b94 | Placeholders, timestamps, captions. 4.5:1 on surface in both themes; avoid on surface-sunken for long text. |

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */

/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
```


### Tokens (19)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--bg` | #f6f6f4 | #0e1014 | App canvas behind every page. Never put body text directly on it in dense areas; use surface. |
| `--primary` | #2450d6 | #7090ff | The one primary action per view, links, selected nav, focus. Pair text on it with on-primary. |
| `--primary-hover` | #1c41b3 | #8ca6ff | Hover/pressed state of primary fills. |
| `--primary-soft` | #e9eefc | #1a2340 | Selected rows, active nav item background, info banners. |
| `--primary-text` | #1c3fae | #aabdff | Text on primary-soft; link text on surface. |
| `--agent` | #6d28d9 | #b2a3c8 | Marks anything an AI agent produced or is doing: agent avatar, run indicator, insight label. Always paired with the sparkle icon and a text label, never color alone. |
| `--agent-soft` | #f1ebfd | #24202d | Background of agent messages, insight cards and suggestion chips. |
| `--agent-text` | #5b21b6 | #d9cee8 | Text on agent-soft. |
| `--success` | #15803d | #4ade80 | Completed steps, positive deltas, healthy status dots. |
| `--success-soft` | #e6f5eb | #0f2a1a | Success badge and banner background. |
| `--success-text` | #166534 | #86efac | Text on success-soft; positive delta text on surface. |
| `--warning` | #b45309 | #fbbf24 | Needs attention: pending approval, low confidence, nearing a limit. |
| `--warning-soft` | #fdf2dc | #33260b | Warning badge, approval card header, banner background. |
| `--warning-text` | #8a3c0b | #fcd34d | Text on warning-soft. |
| `--danger` | #c42727 | #f87171 | Destructive actions, failed runs, errors, negative deltas. |
| `--danger-soft` | #fdeaea | #3a1414 | Error banner and failed badge background. |
| `--danger-text` | #9f1c1c | #fca5a5 | Text on danger-soft; negative delta text on surface. |
| `--focus` | #2450d6 | #8ca6ff | 2px keyboard focus ring with a 2px offset in the page color. |
| `--overlay` | rgba(16, 18, 24, 0.45) | rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6) | Scrim behind dialogs and drawers. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 600 28px/36px "Inter", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.02em;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-text-display); letter-spacing: -0.02em;
font-family: var(--font-sans);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line, italic, letter spacing | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text-display` | `.text-display`, `--text-text-display` | 28px / 36px, letter-spacing -0.02em | 600 | `sans` | One per page at most: dashboard or report title. |
| `text-title` | `.text-title`, `--text-text-title` | 20px / 28px, letter-spacing -0.01em | 600 | `sans` | Page header title. |
| `text-heading` | `.text-heading`, `--text-text-heading` | 16px / 24px | 600 | `sans` | Card and section headings. |
| `text-body` | `.text-body`, `--text-text-body` | 14px / 20px | 400 | `sans` | Default UI text: forms, tables, messages. |
| `text-body-strong` | `.text-body-strong`, `--text-text-body-strong` | 14px / 20px | 500 | `sans` | Labels, button text, emphasized cells. |
| `text-small` | `.text-small`, `--text-text-small` | 13px / 18px | 400 | `sans` | Descriptions, helper text, secondary table text. |
| `text-caption` | `.text-caption`, `--text-text-caption` | 12px / 16px, letter-spacing 0.01em | 500 | `sans` | Badges, column headers, axis labels. Never for paragraphs. |
| `text-metric` | `.text-metric`, `--text-text-metric` | 28px / 32px, letter-spacing -0.02em | 600 | `sans` | KPI numbers on stat cards. Use tabular numerals. |
| `text-mono` | `.text-mono`, `--text-text-mono` | 12.5px / 20px | 400 | `mono` | IDs, tool-call arguments, logs, code. |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sans` | `--font-sans` | `"Inter", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif` |
| `mono` | `--font-mono` | `"JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, monospace` |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (8)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-1` | 4px | Icon-to-label gap, badge padding. |
| `--space-2` | 8px | Gap between related controls; compact cell padding. |
| `--space-3` | 12px | Table cell horizontal padding; field label to input. |
| `--space-4` | 16px | Card padding (compact), gap between form fields. |
| `--space-5` | 20px | Card padding (default). |
| `--space-6` | 24px | Gap between cards in a grid; page gutter on desktop. |
| `--space-8` | 32px | Gap between page sections. |
| `--space-12` | 48px | Empty-state vertical padding. |


| `--shadow-overlay` | 0 8px 24px rgba(16, 18, 24, 0.12), 0 2px 6px rgba(16, 18, 24, 0.08) · dark: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5), 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) | Only floating layers: menus, popovers, dialogs, toasts. In-flow cards use border, not shadow. |
